title: QiSens, the full default pipeline with B zero shot (YOLO26 x on GPU0, Qwen3 VL 8B on GPU1, VLM 3 s windows, 2 frames, 4 slots), 3 repeats with the GT
model: YOLO26 x pose; engine_b/w10-engine-b-v1.pt; SigLIP 2 so400m patch14 384; Qwen3 VL 8B Instruct Q4_K_M

rows.setting: eval frame accuracy over the 3 repeats
rows.note: the first reported repeat: 92.97 / 100 / 100,100,100 / MAE 8.37 s (F1 and MAE of the other repeats not reported)

findings: Headline: the full default pipeline runs in 270.62 s median (270.28 to 270.96) on the 9.9 min QiSens video, under the 300 s gate, with frame accuracy median 93.40 over 3 repeats (92.97 to 93.40; target 85). The repeat with 92.97 had edit 100, F1 100,100,100 and MAE 8.37 s.
The eval differs between the repeats (92.97 to 93.40) because the VLM outputs are not bit identical with parallel slots (w11-vlm-determinism); with 1 slot they are, at 1.7x the VLM time.
The VLM setting chosen on public data (3 s, 2 frames, 4 slots) keeps the accuracy of the 2 s, 4 frame run (93.20, w11-qisens-zero-shot).
conclusion: B zero shot meets both critical gates on QiSens: frame accuracy median 93.40 (92.97 to 93.40) and 270.62 s for the full run.

cells: full run 270.62 s median (270.28 to 270.96); frame accuracy median 93.40 (92.97 to 93.40), 3 repeats
